_doc: Edits made by the eval lane to heldout-v2 after reading the independent check (review.py). Applied by build_set.py after review verdicts. Each entry says why.

V04-02.gold_answer: No. While actually operating, you can't do anything that diverts your attention, including using a cell phone, except for signal communications. If a phone is used for signals, the signal-device rules in §1926.1420 apply: the device must be tested on site before operations begin, signals must go through a dedicated channel (subject to that section's exceptions), and your reception must be hands-free.
V04-02.note: The independent check's correction named §1926.1421 (voice signals); the device test, dedicated channel and hands-free rules are §1926.1420(a)-(c). Found by the adversarial review.
